question: Why did European net deposits fall in the week starting August 3?

final_answer.headline: A supported financial-operations driver was identified.
findings: European net deposits changed by $-223,901.70 week over week (2026-07-27–2026-08-02 versus 2026-08-03–2026-08-09).
Deposits changed by $24,365.52, while withdrawals changed by $248,267.22; the decomposition exactly reconstructs the net-deposit movement.
The largest 11 European customer withdrawals account for 92.2% of current-week European withdrawals.
Europe's weekly net-deposit movement per registered customer was $-33.07, versus a median of $-0.73 across the other regions.

A high-value withdrawal-cluster event is present in the nearby operational event log. Together with the measured withdrawal concentration, this is a supported observed driver, not evidence of why individual customers withdrew.
final_answer.guardrail: The evidence supports concentrated high-value withdrawals as an observed driver of the synthetic net-deposit deterioration. It does not establish why those customers withdrew or justify an investment, compliance, or customer-risk conclusion without additional evidence.
